name: DevVibe Studio - Sample Partial Review
summary: Bounded review inspected 2 accessible pages. Found 3 security/privacy header issues with practical code fixes. 1 section (/dashboard) requires authentication and could not be assessed.

findings.title: Missing `X-Frame-Options` Header
findings.why_it_matters: Leaves the website susceptible to clickjacking attacks where malicious sites frame the page.
findings.evidence: Inspected root HTTP response headers on http://127.0.0.1:8088/hybrid_app
findings.action: Add `X-Frame-Options: DENY` or `SAMEORIGIN` to your reverse proxy or headers config.

findings.title: Missing `Referrer-Policy` Header
findings.why_it_matters: Browsers may send full referrer URLs containing sensitive query parameters to external destinations.
findings.how_to_verify: Verify via browser network tab or curl response header.

findings.title: Missing Content-Security-Policy (CSP)
findings.observed: No `Content-Security-Policy` header found on root response.
findings.why_it_matters: Without CSP, the browser has no baseline restrictions against loading unauthorized scripts or resources.
findings.action: Define a CSP header: `Content-Security-Policy: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self';`.
findings.how_to_verify: Check that browser console enforces the declared CSP policy.

positive_observations.observation: Document has a clear browser title.
Interactive entry points and buttons are discoverable.
Mobile viewport meta tag is present.
Discovered images include descriptive alt text.
positive_observations.evidence: Verified 1 image with valid alt text

positive_observations.observation: Public pricing structure is clearly published.

unassessed_areas.reason: HTTP 401 Protected Resource (Unauthorized). Authentication credentials required.
unassessed_areas.required_access: Provide test account credentials (username/password) or session bearer token.

unassessed_areas.reason: Public review does not inspect server-side databases or private repositories.
unassessed_areas.required_access: Connect repository (GitHub/GitLab) or authorize white-box assessment.

unassessed_areas.reason: Adversarial prompt injection testing requires explicit scoped authorization.
unassessed_areas.required_access: Select 'AI Chatbot or Local Model' in Step 1 and authorize active testing.

next_steps: Deploy X-Frame-Options and Content-Security-Policy headers in hosting configuration.
To assess /dashboard: provide test credentials or session token.
For active AI red-teaming: launch a dedicated AI model assessment with explicit authorization.
